items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: when I come back is when I started working with Sid

ctx.x: How long did you live down in Los Angeles then? From 1915, you say you moved out about.
Yes. And then, let's see, in 1918, I was drafted in World War I. Went to France, and when I come back is when I started working with Sid. And I left. After that? Yes.
